summary: Iter61 re-test of the iter60 fixes. Backend: the new suite tests/test_competition_phase_dates_iter61.py passed 33/33, and the regression suites (iter59 hardening, chamber draws/redraw, iter60 flags) passed 50/50. FIX1 verified: legacy comps (missing tickets_mode/competition_type/purchase_mode/max_tickets) and numeric-string fields can be edited after entries (200), and the real seeded comp 6ab6206a…bc was edited and then restored. Changes to the 7 locked fields still return 409 with the field name. FIX2 verified: phase is consistent across /competitions/{id}, /chamber/competitions and /full for open, soon, waiting, ready (with and without a same-day draw_date) and drawn. GET /competitions no longer writes status. FIX3 verified: an end_date of today keeps entries open and join returns 200 on the last day. draw_opens_at is the next day at 00:00+03:00. Creating with a past end, draw before end, a bad format, an empty end or start after end returns 422; a same-day draw is allowed. FIX4: login takes about 0.32s. FIX6: UGC draw_ready is false and initial-session POST is rejected. Bcrypt uses $2b$ and lockout triggers on the 6th attempt. Frontend at 375px: chamber pills are correct in AR (بانتظار موعد السحب / المشاركة مفتوحة) and EN (Awaiting draw date / Entries open / Ready to draw / Draw opens on …), with no 'Withdraw' wording. On /competition/{id}, start date, 'آخر يوم للمشاركة' and draw date show as YYYY-MM-DD, and the locked note differs between open and closed. UGC has no draw-btn. A customer sees the join button only on the open comp. A merchant UI edit of a comp with entries returns PUT 200 and is persisted. Minor issues remain (see below).

minor.issue: The public endpoint pops correct_answer, and competition-form.tsx loads edit data from it. Editing a QA comp therefore loads without the answer: the client blocks with 'السؤال والإجابة الصحيحة مطلوبان', or the backend returns 422 until the merchant re-stars the answer (and picking a different one after entries returns 409).

An ended UGC comp that is not yet finalised returns phase='waiting' indefinitely, because draw_ready is always false. The chamber shows 'بانتظار موعد السحب' and a locked box reading 'السحب يفتح في <past date>' (e.g. 2026-11-02), which is misleading because UGC winners are picked by likes via auto-finalize.

ui_bugs.issue: Only comp-end-date and comp-draw-date have placeholderTextColor. The title, description, prize, question, options, ugc_hashtag and permit_number inputs (lines 128, 130, 132, 179, 186, 225, 249) render their placeholder in the same black as typed text on web, so it looks like a real value (e.g. 'سحب العيد الكبير').

'تاريخ السحب' falls back to end_date when draw_date is empty (and shows end_date for UGC), but the draw actually opens at draw_opens_at, which is the next day. Use day(comp.draw_opens_at) and hide the row for ugc_video.
Alert.alert is a no-op on react-native-web, so after a successful PUT the user gets no success feedback and no router.back() on the web preview. Native is fine.

issues: The infoLabel text (Start date / Last day to enter …) and the 'منتهية' badge are very light grey on a light card, so contrast is low.
The modal says 'تاريخ الانتهاء' while the competition page says 'آخر يوم للمشاركة'. Use one term so it is clear that the end date is inclusive.

action_items: competition-form edit: load from a merchant-scoped endpoint that includes correct_answer (or return correct_answer for the owning merchant), so QA comps can be edited.
Add placeholderTextColor (muted, e.g. #9CA3AF) to the remaining 7 TextInputs in merchant/competition-form.tsx.
UGC: give it its own phase/label (e.g. 'بانتظار اعتماد الفائز بالإعجابات') and hide the 'السحب يفتح في' locked box in chamber.tsx for ugc_video.
competition/[id].tsx: show day(draw_opens_at) for 'تاريخ السحب' and hide the row for UGC.
Optional: raise the infoLabel contrast; use a web-friendly success toast instead of Alert.alert in the form.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /merchant/competitions/{cid} does not check created_by_merchant == user.id (it relies only on require_merchant). This is fine for a single store but worth guarding.

validate_dates on PUT requires end_date for non-UGC comps, so a legacy comp without an end_date can only be edited if an end_date is also added (allowed via SET_ONCE). This is acceptable but should be documented.
_end_ts treats only exactly-10-character values as date-only. A value such as '2026-11-3' fails isoformat parsing (422), which is fine.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all fix flows pass; minor placeholder/UGC label issues)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ITER61_* comps were created and all removed (0 left). The seeded legacy comp 6ab6206a71b6ad54069c12bc was restored to its original doc. The 15k comp 6ae9a4a5b4ef244d1d1c4c5e is untouched: status open, 0 draw sessions, 15000 entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server clock is 2026-11-03 ~09:50 UTC. Use the D(n) Saudi-day helper in test_competition_phase_dates_iter61.py. Run 'python3 tests/ui_seed_iter61.py' to create the waiting/ugc/open UI comps assigned to chamber 0550000000, and 'python3 tests/ui_seed_iter61.py clean' to remove them. UI language is set via localStorage app_lang ('ar'/'en'). Draw sessions endpoint: POST /api/draws/{cid}/sessions.
rca_of_issue: Iter60 legacy-edit 409 root cause (missing field != pydantic default) is fixed by competition_rules._norm, which uses DEFAULTS and float coercion. The QA edit issue is caused by the form reading the public endpoint that strips correct_answer.
